tags.instructions: Use this for CRM or other external-record blocking, not a manually queued LinkedIn URL. Identify the workspace with `list-workspaces` and retain the source/external ID pair. Supply the complete desired identities each time: updates replace that record's previous contribution. Company domains block everyone there; freemail domains are refused. Use `remove-do-not-contact-record` to lift only this contribution.
